oftlaunch: OFT kits have moved into the Log Book. No more FedEx. Every kit now gets its own tracking number, and you can follow it all the way to the collation branch.
Here's how it works. You collect the sample from your client. Then open the Log Book and choose OFT Kit.
Pick your client and the policy, straight from Salesforce. One kit per line.
Press log, and your tracking number appears. R R B, O F T, then today's date, then the kit's own number. Write it on the kit.
Then hand the kit to sales support. They sign for it on their phone, and you get an e-mail the moment they do.
Sales support builds the transmittal, and picks this quarter's collation branch from the list. Every kit and every tracking number, on one page.
Need to find a kit? Search the tracking number, the policy, or your client's name. You'll see who had it, and when.
So from today, log every OFT kit in the Log Book. Ricky Rampersad branch dot com, slash log book.
